name: Dunlandi 24V Cordless Drill Machine Set | 2 Batteries & Complete DIY Tool Kit
description:
Upgrade your toolkit with the Dunlandi 24V Cordless Drill Machine Set, designed for home improvement, furniture assembly, repairs, and DIY projects. Powered by a high-performance motor and 2 rechargeable 1.5Ah lithium batteries, it delivers cordless convenience and long-lasting use. The complete tool kit includes drill bits, screwdriver bits, sockets, pliers, utility knife, tester, tape, and more—neatly packed in a durable blow case for organized storage and easy carrying.
Key Features
 24V cordless drill with dual batteries
 Multi-functional use: wood, metal, plastic, fastening
 Complete tool kit with essential accessories
 Compact, portable, and easy to carry
How to Use
 Insert the battery and select the drill bit
 Adjust torque/speed as per material
 Use correct accessory for fastening or drilling
 Recharge battery after use for best performance
Material
ABS Plastic, Stainless Steel, Lithium Battery
Safety Information
 Wear safety glasses during drilling
 Keep away from children
 Remove battery when not in use
 Do not use in wet conditions
Package Includes
 1 × 24V Cordless Electric Drill (10mm chuck)
 2 × Rechargeable Lithium Batteries (1.5Ah)
 1 × Charger
 Drill Bits, Screwdriver Bits & Socket Bits with Extender & Adaptor
 1 × Flexible Soft Shaft
 1 × Long Nose Pliers
 1 × Utility Knife
 2 × Screwdrivers (Cross & Slotted)
 1 × Digital Display Test Pen
 1 × Measuring Tape
 1 × PVC Insulating Tape
 1 × Durable Blow Case
